text: change up how this registers, it should be how you resolve a request is the build note. not my request itself. my request is effectively a 'bug report' or 'feature request' and these are the delivery of those
resolution: Changed the build journal registration contract so a build note is created only from a resolved request delivery, not from the user's ask text. Runtime BuildJournal.ingestRequest now skips entries without a resolution, batch ingest filters unresolved asks, and tests lock that open bug/feature requests cannot advance latestBuildNumber. The editor snapshot now collects recent delivered entries only, derives the dock build from the newest delivered request, titles/body text from the resolution, and shows the original request separately as context.
